node: Compound-semiconductor photonics tools, substrates, epitaxy, etch, bonding, and test
summary: Layer 1B expansion found a compact US-listed universe around the compound-photonics manufacturing chokepoint. The strongest direct tool exposure is Veeco, which disclosed more than $250M of InP laser manufacturing equipment orders tied to silicon photonics, 800G, 1.6T, and hyperscale data centers. Coherent and Lumentum are reference product leaders and direct demand anchors because they own or operate InP photonics platforms, laser/device capacity, and AI/data-center optical products. Aeluma is a speculative small-cap shadow candidate because its III-V-on-200mm/300mm-silicon platform could be relevant if native InP capacity remains constrained, but commercial proof and AI optical revenue evidence need verification.
